title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability… (CVE-2026-114528)
description: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Zero Point allows Stored XSS. This issue affects Zero Point versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.30.0, from 2.0.0 to 2.0.1.
